summary: Tested the Admin Analytics dashboard, AI usage tracking, compute pricing, per-user compute and the Doctor caveat. Backend: 26/26 pytest passed. That covers auth (401 with no login, 403 for pro/free/beta), the analytics response shape, totals matching across endpoints, pricing validation and cost recompute, PATCH role->pro setting pro_since (pro_month +1), and one real AI call each for MMD, MME, MLG (list-draft), MPA (aisles), MMS and BMMS (scan with batch=true). Every call recorded tokens > 0 under the right feature. Frontend at 390x844: account-analytics-item goes to /admin/analytics. All tiles render, the refresh button and 30s auto-refresh update analytics-updated, and the pricing form saves (NZD 100/200 changed costs to 'NZD 1.55') and was restored. User tiers show compute month/all per user and the sort select reorders. A pro user is redirected away from /admin/analytics and has no menu item. The Doctor caveat shows directly under the label. No horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: pro_since is left on a user after they are demoted to free. If an existing pro is set to free and back to pro, pro_since resets to now and they count as 'Pro this month' again. This is acceptable but worth knowing.
pro_since is only set when it is missing, so a user who lapses and re-subscribes in a later month is not counted in 'Pro users this month'.

design_issues.screen: AdminAnalytics feature tiles / Admin user rows
issues: No singular/plural handling: '1 uses', '1 AI calls'
Sort uses tokens only. Users with backfilled 0-token calls tie with users who never used AI (e.g. the admin with 1 AI call sorts last); could tie-break on uses
The 'Sort users' label wraps onto 2 lines at 390px
admin-sort-select is a native <select>, not a shadcn Select (it matches the existing role selects)
An empty number field is sent as 0 (Number('')) and saved without warning

action_items: Optional: tie-break the compute sort on uses
Optional: check for empty pricing inputs before saving
critical_code_review_comments: Usage recording correctly uses emergentintegrations Usage dataclass attributes; failures with usage are still recorded
users_month relies on string comparison of mixed ISO formats ('Z' vs '+00:00'); works because the prefixes sort correctly, but storing datetimes would be more robust
token_totals $addToSet of user_ids per group is fine at current scale but grows unbounded
